description: Spot colours (pdfnative 1.9.0 through pdfnative-mcp 1.8.0): print.spotColours declares two inks with a process alternate — a brand blue with a CMYK alternate for a press job and a varnish plate — and the document paints them anywhere a colour is accepted: the header rule at { spot } (/Separation, solid), a table border at { spot, tint } and a second table border with an ink mix { inks } (/DeviceN). Each ink becomes a colorant a RIP shows as its own plate; an ink painted without a declaration is refused by name (VALIDATION_ERROR). creationDate pins the bytes.

blocks.text: The table borders below are painted with a declared spot ink at a 40 % tint, then with a mix of the two inks. The /DeviceN tint transform carries the CMYK alternates, so a proof without the plates still shows the colours.
